stage_semantics.lift: 拿起: native lifted_object flag; elevation alone does not establish a secure grasp.
stage_semantics.hold: 拿稳: existing12tick two-finger/elevation/palm-relative-motion diagnostic; failure does not prove a drop.
stage_semantics.turn: 转正: report raw object-root/goal-root quaternion angle at the same recorded tick, including after first stable hold. No new success threshold; shape symmetries are not removed.
stage_semantics.near: 对孔接近: native near_goal keypoint condition; root distance alone is not this condition.
stage_semantics.preinsert: 对孔子目标: first native subgoal event. Historical alignment_cases names native _is_success after its near-goal counter, not an independent orientation criterion.
stage_semantics.insert: 插入: original native final completion/max_successes; neither offline error nor an intermediate flag establishes completion.
stage_semantics.pose: All historical center_distance fields are root-reference-origin distances, not collision-AABB centers. New phase snapshots use the goal before the transition, because diagnostics_after may already contain the next goal at a native subgoal event.
stage_semantics.order: Milestone counts are independent marginals, not a guaranteed nested funnel. Post-hold turning snapshots explicitly require a prior stable window. Ticks are1-based completed transitions.

source_autonomous.scope: Previously completed source evaluation; same ordered reset specifications, separate timing/cohort. Not part of the new interleaved comparison and not exact hidden-state pairs.

limits: Matched source trunk/buffers and zeroed final Linear, frozen DP/data/cache, equal actual unweighted updates. The inherited trunk was trained with nominal coordinates. Fixed validation6 selects trained checkpoints. Motion and error metrics use the registered learned recovery histories and do not replace autonomous behavior. Interleaved autonomous cells share registered opportunities, not exact hidden simulator state. No automatic promotion.
